# santi020k/private-website

Modern personal portfolio and blog built with Astro, React, and Tailwind CSS. Optimized for performance (98+ Lighthouse) and developer experience.

## Tech Stack
- **Framework**: [Astro 6.0+](https://astro.build)
- **Styling**: [Tailwind CSS 4.0+](https://tailwindcss.com)
- **Components**: [React](https://reactjs.org), [Alpine.js](https://alpinejs.dev)
- **Content**: MDX, [Astro Content Collections](https://docs.astro.build/en/guides/content-collections/)
- **Testing**: [Vitest](https://vitest.dev), [Playwright](https://playwright.dev)
- **CI/CD**: GitHub Actions
- **Formatting/Linting**: ESLint (Flat Config), Husky, lint-staged

## Project Structure
- `/src/content/`: All content collections (posts, projects, notes, types)
- `/src/pages/`: Dynamic and static routes
- `/src/components/`: Reusable UI components
- `/src/layouts/`: Base layouts for pages and articles
- `/src/utils/`: Business logic and helpers
- `/.github/workflows/`: CI/CD pipelines
- `/.husky/`: Git hooks for local quality checks

## Key Configs
- `astro.config.mjs`: Main framework configuration
- `eslint.config.js`: Custom Flat Config extending `@santi020k/eslint-config-basic`
- `package.json`: Dependency and script manifest
- `llms.txt`: This file (for AI agents)

## Guidelines
- Follow Conventional Commits.
- Ensure 100% accessibility (A11y) for all content.
- Maintain high Lighthouse scores.
- Use `npm run dev` for local development.
